installCommand: if [ -f package.json ] && [ -f code-quest/package.json ]; then npm install --prefix code-quest; elif [ -f package.json ]; then npm install; else echo 'No package.json found'; exit 1; fi
buildCommand: if [ -f package.json ] && [ -f code-quest/package.json ]; then npm --prefix code-quest run build; elif [ -f package.json ]; then npm run build; else echo 'No package.json found'; exit 1; fi
